## Ontology terms

| term | definition | notes |
|---|---|---|
| component target | `ComponentTarget{kind ∈ {slot, variant, rule, parameter, procedure, text_leaf, decision_point}, ref: semantic_id \| (run_id, seq, DecisionPoint), class_id?, ir_refs[]}` — the unit credit is assigned to; a shared inlined procedure resolves to one target through `derived-from`. | WS-I7 ADR-1; T-LCD-02 (opaque leaves targetable), T-LCD-10 (by `semantic_id`). |
| attribution estimand | The declared quantity an attribution effect estimates: `LOI` / `LOO` (whole-run paired Δ with a target added / removed), `TE_marg` (intervene at a fork, fresh downstream noise — interventional), `TE_crn` (intervene, downstream noise coupled), `DE` (natural direct effect, downstream actions pinned), `ME = TE_crn − DE`, `shapley` (average marginal contribution over coalitions). Each has a replay-validity floor. | WS-I7 ADR-1 D2; S-WS-I7-03 names, Pearl semantics. |
| attribution design / attribution report / attribution hypothesis | `AttributionDesign` (subject, method, targets, fork policy, `k`, requested replay mode, noise coupling, `MatchSpec`, outcome, instrument budget, seed, pre-registration) desugaring to an `ExperimentSpec`; `AttributionReport/1` (the additive extension of J4 A10: `effects[]` with estimand/validity/change rate/noise floor, `shapley?`, `locus?`, shares, budget, labels); `AttributionHypothesis` (model- or human-authored targets + rationale, `label = observational`, never a value). | WS-I7 ADR-1/-2; stored as `AnalysisRecord` (ADR-0162). |
| attribution label | `observational \| designed_ablation \| causal_interventional \| causal_coupled` — the evidence class of an attribution; the evolution pipeline's label gate reads it. | WS-I7 ADR-3. |
| null intervention | The factual re-execution arm (ADR-0135 D6) read as `do_resample` at the fork point: same policy, no intervention record; its dispersion is the noise floor. | Reuses B4's *factual re-execution arm*; CAR `do_resample`. |
| point of commitment (causal locus) | For per-decision-point `TE_marg` effects, the latest decision point whose interval still excludes 0 — the last point at which re-deciding still changes the outcome; a labelled heuristic (`rule = point_of_commitment`), reported beside the per-target effects and beside `earliest_direct` when `DE` is available. | WS-I7 ADR-2; S-WS-I7-01. |
| run-forward confound | Resampling any decision point re-rolls every later stochastic point, so an inert upstream point can show an effect by re-rolling the true pivot; why magnitude ranking is not localization. | S-WS-I7-01; S-WS-I7-03 Prop. 1; KA-I7-3 fixture. |
| noise coupling / coupled source / coupling agreement | `noise_coupling ∈ {none, crn}` on an attribution design: whether the factual and counterfactual branch of one replicate share exogenous draws keyed by `(seed, replicate_index, fork_point)`; `coupled_sources[]` lists the nondeterminism sources actually coupled; `coupling_agreement` is the measured fraction of coupled draws that agreed. Distinct from B4's `coupling_assumption` (edit/side-effect coupling). | WS-I7 ADR-1 D7; CF-WS-I7-02/-05; S-WS-I7-16. |
| change rate | The fraction of factual-arm branches whose action at the fork point differs from the recorded one; `change_rate = 0` (`PolicyCollapsed`) means nothing is estimable at that point. | S-WS-I7-03 failure 1; validity V4. |
| noise floor | The dispersion of the factual arm's outcome distribution at a fork point, always reported beside an effect. | ADR-0135 D6 restated. |
| unattributed share / interaction share / efficiency check | `unattributed_share = Δ − Σ single-target effects` (single-target effects are not a decomposition); `interaction_share` = pairwise Shapley interaction index; `efficiency_check = Σφ − Δ_set` for coalition credit (must lie within the report's interval). | WS-I7 ADR-2; S-WS-I7-10/-12. |
| budget-splitting trap | The failure in which an optimization budget split uniformly across components leaves each below its search floor, so every component reads as null; made visible by rendering `SearchBudgetRecord.allocation` beside M1 effects and never pooling allocations. | S-092; KA-I7-4. |
| known-effect fixture | A Harness Definition compiled under the null profile and executed against a fake/recording gateway with a declared conditional decision distribution, so a planted effect (pivotal, inert, AND-interaction, trap) is known by construction; or an injected-fault corpus over a real suite. | WS-I7 ADR-3; CAR `synthetic_scms.py`; AgenTracer injection. |
| attribution_quality vs attribution_completeness | `attribution_quality` (evolvability metric): share of a matched configuration-level Δ covered by attributed component effects, with interval. `attribution_completeness` (security/E5 veto, ADR-0101): fraction of effects resolvable to a kernel-minted attribution token. Same word, two objects. | CF-WS-I7-03. |
